Hi Emma —

Thanks again for the productive conversation yesterday. Per our agreement, I attached an updated mutual action plan (Cortico_MAP_v3.xlsx) that stitches legal and procurement dependencies to the evaluation runbook and order form milestones. The goal here is to compress time-to-signature while keeping acceptance gates clear.

High-level ask: can Cortico confirm a target signature window (date range) for the MSA + DPA + Order Form so we can lock internal resources and propose a cadence of MAP standups? If procurement has any internal blackout weeks (budget freezes, fiscal close, holiday blocks), flag them so we avoid false expectations.

Key dependencies called out in the MAP:
- MSA redlines: legal review + counter-redline (we propose internal target: 5 business days)
- DPA: run in parallel with MSA where possible; data mapping appendix needed from your privacy team
- Order Form: pricing lock and PO path — order form is the last signer; needs final SKU/pricing confirmation before DocuSign packet creation
- Acceptance criteria & pilot schedule: evaluation runbook must be agreed prior to provisioning dedicated capacity

Proposed cadence (if this works for Cortico):
- Twice-weekly 30-minute MAP standups (Mon / Wed, 9:00am PT) until signature
- Weekly legal sync (30m) if redlines are active
- A single owner per lane in the MAP (I've added suggested owners in the sheet)

Attachments: Cortico_MAP_v3.xlsx, initial MSA_redlines_v1.pdf, OrderForm_Draft.docx (draft pricing)

Next steps for us: if you confirm a tentative signature window (e.g., week of Dec 14 or Dec 21) we'll schedule the standups and produce a locked DocuSign packet for review.
